channel.title: Security Council Committee established pursuant to resolution 1718 (2006)
channel.description: Key milestones of the 1718 Sanctions Committee (DPRK) and the related Security Council sanctions resolutions. Source: main.un.org/securitycouncil/en/sanctions/1718

item.title: Panel of Experts: mandate ended on 30 April 2024
item.description: From 2009 to 30 April 2024, the Committee was supported by a Panel of Experts, whose mandate was renewed yearly until that date.

item.title: New designations under resolution 2397 (2017)
item.description: On 30 March 2018, the Committee designated 1 individual and 21 entities. The 1718 Sanctions List currently holds 80 individuals and 75 entities.

item.title: Resolution 2397 (2017)
item.description: Caps on refined petroleum products and crude oil, bans on industrial machinery, metals and other items, and repatriation of DPRK workers abroad.

item.title: Resolution 2375 (2017)
item.description: Ban on DPRK textile exports, ban on joint ventures with DPRK entities, and new measures on vessel inspections.

item.title: Resolution 2371 (2017)
item.description: Bans on DPRK coal and seafood exports, and an assets freeze applying to designated vessels.

item.title: Resolution 2321 (2016)
item.description: Additional financial measures, restrictions on vessels, and bans on statues and new helicopters.

item.title: Resolution 2270 (2016)
item.description: Arms embargo catch-all clause, cargo inspections, financial measures and a ban on aviation and rocket fuel.

item.title: Committee designates an additional entity
item.description: On 28 July 2014, the Committee designated one additional entity.

item.title: Resolution 2094 (2013)
item.description: Three new individuals and two new entities designated, and the listing criteria expanded.

item.title: Resolution 2087 (2013)
item.description: Four additional individuals and six entities designated, and the listing criteria expanded to cover sanctions evasion.

item.title: Resolution 1874 (2009): Panel of Experts established
item.description: The Council establishes the Panel of Experts to support the work of the 1718 Committee.

item.title: Resolution 1718 (2006): Committee established
item.description: The 1718 Committee is established on 14 October 2006 to oversee the sanctions measures relating to the DPRK.
